svg.title: full-multi — AS IS Implementation (Istio VirtualService Delegation)
svg.desc: Original three-tier architecture overview, showing one root ingress VirtualService delegating to separate Application A and B frontend VirtualServices, plus independent backend and CRUD mesh VirtualServices. Stable and canary rows are visual routing paths, not distinct duplicated VirtualService resources.
